## Query

```sql
SELECT
  project, version, blockchain,
  COUNT(*)                 AS n_eventos,
  COUNT(DISTINCT borrower) AS n_borrowers,
  MIN(block_time)          AS primeiro,
  MAX(block_time)          AS ultimo
FROM lending.borrow
WHERE project IN ('aave','compound')
  AND transaction_type = 'borrow'
GROUP BY 1, 2, 3
ORDER BY project, n_borrowers DESC
```
